description: This file defines the PHP class 'Image_Graph_Figure_Circle', which extends 'Image_Graph_Figure_Ellipse' to represent a circle shape in a graph rendering library. It includes constructor logic to initialize a circle's position and radius, leveraging inheritance from the Ellipse class.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Figure_Circle
classes.description: A class representing a circle shape in the graph rendering library, inheriting from 'Image_Graph_Figure_Ellipse', used for drawing circles based on center and radius.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Figure_Circle
methods.description: Constructor for the 'Image_Graph_Figure_Circle' class, initializing a circle with center coordinates ($x, $y) and a radius, by calling the parent constructor of 'Image_Graph_Figure_Ellipse'.
